title: Whose Boat Does it Float? Improving Personalization in Preference Tuning via Inferred User Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing token saliency in LLM-inferred user personas to reveal implicit dataset preferences for longer, meticulous outputs over concise ones, and explicitly controlling for output length (matching sentence counts) during pairwise LLM judge evaluations.

Qualitatively evaluating model responses to adversarial or misinformed personas (e.g., users who prefer anecdotal data or want to mislead others about climate change) to observe if the model generates inaccurate or sycophantic text to match the persona.

Qualitatively testing model outputs by injecting sensitive demographic personas (e.g., 'The user is a black male') to identify if the personalization mechanism inappropriately induces stereotyped or offensive associations.
